procurement_observation.scope: Read-only page observation, not reserved stock; no order

screening: Datasheet has no 1.8 V on-resistance guarantee; 2.5 V minimum gate drive must be established for each branch.
Typical capacitances are not maxima and were measured at 25 V, not the low-voltage circuit operating point.
10 uA leakage specified at +/-20 V cannot be treated as actual GPIO-voltage leakage or a full-temperature guarantee.
If 10 uA is used as a conservative hypothetical sink, Q3 100k/1M gate network shifts by 0.909 V and Q4 10k/100k by 0.0909 V. These are sensitivity calculations, not measured device behavior.
Manufacturer product webpage Ciss 22 pF differs from downloaded PDF 23.2 pF; use versioned PDF for this screening.
Pin drawing, actual drive minima, temperature behavior and SETI transient assessment remain pending.
